body.x: SEOUL, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2005') -- <Visual News> ASIANA IDT(www.asianaidt.com) has introduced its new headset ‘earomix’. It is a versatile headset that you can use it as wireless headphone at ordinary times, and once it is out of battery, you can also use it as wired one by using cable.

It uses the same frequency of 2.4GHz as wireless LAN, so you can use it in any place. It works within 10m. It is compatible with almost AV devices by utilizing audio adapter. Another model of Asiana IDT presented in KES 2005 is a wireless headset with an adapter for iPod Nano. If you place iPod Nano upon the adapter, it is automatically charged.
